_comment: Provenance for transcript_full-fixture.jsonl (antigravity's OWN vendor-native step-log format — the adapter's INPUT) and golden.transcript.acp.jsonl (the canonical schema the adapter must produce — the EXPECTED OUTPUT). Mirrors the provenance discipline of ../../codex/testdata/MANIFEST.json and ../../../testdata/fixtures/MANIFEST.json (memory 'silent-no-op-failure-mode': assert on real payload content, never just entry counts).

transcript_full-fixture.jsonl.real_source: ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/c205bcb8-2ea4-41ed-87e7-627c56acb126/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl (a live antigravity CLI session on this box, driven through ctxloom's own sentinel-file verification pattern: 'write XXX-OVERWRITTEN-XXX into sentinel.txt')
transcript_full-fixture.jsonl.copied_verbatim: the ENTIRE file is copied byte-for-byte, not hand-trimmed — all 16 real steps, including the one USER_INPUT (wrapped in <USER_REQUEST>/<ADDITIONAL_METADATA>/<USER_SETTINGS_CHANGE>) and seven real PLANNER_RESPONSE steps, plus every step type this adapter deliberately does NOT convert (CONVERSATION_HISTORY, GENERIC, CHECKPOINT, LIST_DIRECTORY, RUN_COMMAND [status RUNNING - exercises the stepDone gate], SYSTEM_MESSAGE, CODE_ACTION, VIEW_FILE) so the golden output proves those are skipped against REAL data, not a synthesized skip case
transcript_full-fixture.jsonl.synthetic: none - nothing in this fixture is fabricated
transcript_full-fixture.jsonl.why_this_file: of every transcript_full.jsonl on this box (surveyed under ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/*/.system_generated/logs/), this was the richest real capture (16 steps) and the only one exercising every step type this adapter's doc comment discusses by name, including a real 'thinking' field and a real 'tool_calls' array on several PLANNER_RESPONSE steps (both left unconverted - see antigravity.go's package doc for why) and a RUNNING-status step (proves the stepDone gate against real data, not just the synthetic TestConvert_SkipsNonDoneStatus case)

golden.transcript.acp.jsonl.provenance: NOT hand-written - generated by running antigravity.Adapter{}.Convert against transcript_full-fixture.jsonl and capturing the Recorder's output verbatim (see antigravity_test.go's TestConvert_MatchesGolden, which re-generates and diffs against this file on every run - it is a checked-in expectation, not a separate hand-maintained parallel format).
golden.transcript.acp.jsonl.harp/seq/ts: harp and ts are stamped by the test's Recorder construction (NewRecorder's clock is not overridden here - ts reflects wall-clock test-run time, so the golden comparison in antigravity_test.go zeroes/ignores ts and harp fields rather than pinning them; seq is deterministic (0..N in file order) and IS asserted verbatim.
golden.transcript.acp.jsonl.no_session_or_complete_lines: antigravity's native format carries no model/permission-mode/context-window/session-id field anywhere the adapter reads, so Convert never emits a KindSession or KindComplete line - every line in this golden file is kind:"entry", matching the existing hand-captured oneshot-regime fixture (../../../testdata/fixtures/antigravity.transcript.acp.jsonl).
